# Feedback API

> A REST API for collecting, retrieving, filtering, and summarising user feedback. Each feedback item carries a 1-5 star rating, a category (bug / feature / general), a freetext message, and an author handle. All data is persisted in a JSON file.

This API has no authentication. All endpoints accept and return JSON.
Base URL (local dev): http://localhost:3000

## Endpoints

- List feedback: GET /api/feedback — returns all feedback items, supports query-param filtering
- Create feedback: POST /api/feedback — creates a new feedback item
- Get one feedback item: GET /api/feedback/:id — returns a single item by UUID
- Update feedback: PUT /api/feedback/:id — partial update (any field)
- Delete feedback: DELETE /api/feedback/:id — removes item, returns { deleted: true, id }
- Feedback summary: GET /api/feedback/summary — aggregate stats (total, averageRating, byCategory, byRating)
- Full docs: GET /llms-full.txt — complete agent-readable API reference with schemas and examples

## Optional

- Health check: GET /api/health — returns { status: "ok", timestamp }
